emails.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

We acknowledge your renewal proposal and the cost context provided. Please revise the proposal to extend the contract term and payment period and increase call-off flexibility within your existing approval authority.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months, 13,740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 425.71 per unit, 60 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year; option B: EUR 424.29 per unit, 45 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year; option C: EUR 422.87 per unit, 30 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. Option A amounts to about EUR 5,849,255 over the term.
3. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
